          No, Avion points do not expire. Avion points are yours to use as long as your Avion Rewards eligible account remains open and in good standing. However, any unredeemed points will be forfeited twelve (12) months after (i) you voluntarily close your account or (ii) RBC closes your account for any reason other than for cause.
          The value of your points depends on the eligible RBC product you hold and what you want to redeem for. Sign in to www.avionrewards.com to discover the possibilities

          To redeem your points, sign into Avion Rewards online or through the app, then select either “Travel “or “Redeem” in the nav bar or menu.

          For more information and to redeem for flights, visit avionrewards.com/travel.

          Avion points can be converted into American Airlines AAdvantage miles, British Airways Avios and WestJet points.
